title: What Occupational Therapists Do
description: Occupational therapists help people do the activities that matter — dressing, cooking, working, playing — after illness, injury, or disability. They assess abilities, teach new strategies, prescribe adaptive equipment, modify homes, and treat hands and sensory challenges. OT is the profession of independence.
